rows.q: Recommend some calls for me to attend
What data do you have access to?
Who lives in San Diego in MDS?
rows.answer:
I can tap into a few different places:

• *WhatsApp chats and digests* — search messages or pull daily digests to see what was discussed
• *Facebook posts and comments* — pull full threads and hot discussions
• *Member public profiles* — look up niche, expertise, city, fun facts
• *Events* — list upcoming meetups, dinners, virtual calls and who’s going
• *Partner deals* — search negotiated discounts and tools
• *Video library* — find past Mogul Calls, Expert Calls, and webinars by topic or speaker

*Not yet:* I can’t listen inside call recordings — I can only tell you what calls exist and who ran them.
